product_one_liner.value: Levitate helps relationship-based small businesses nurture clients and referrals through AI-assisted personalized email, texting, social media and automated follow-up, supported by a dedicated Success Specialist.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and included features are listed; exact subscription pricing requires a demo quote.

value: Jeffrey Allen Howard Attorney at Law PLLC

employee_band.notes: Inc. reports the 201–500 band; PitchBook reports 431 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index contains marketing advice and product announcements, not a qualifying engineer-authored technical blog.

public_docs.notes: Public help center with multiple documentation categories and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed openings are in sales and revenue operations; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic PBC; Google LLC; OpenAI, LLC
model_provider.notes: The company names these underlying model providers on a disclosure last updated June 12, 2026.

compliance_certs.notes: The company explicitly claims SOC 2 Type I and Type II certification. Its separate HIPAA-readiness/Security Rule attestation is not counted as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced March 5, 2026. The company reports $16 million; PitchBook identifies the round as Series E and reports $15.9 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 5, 2026 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative posting in Toronto; the careers page also lists Raleigh and Tampa SDR openings.

launched_6mo.notes: September 25, 2026 announcement introduced Meeting Prep, Keep in Touch Agent, Email Exec Assistant and the Levitate MCP Server, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Matthew Gardiner’s profile dates his VP of Sales tenure through December 2025; Anna McMahon’s profile dates her SVP of Sales tenure through April 2026. Both departures fall within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is explicitly used internally in the sales-management posting. Salesforce, Redtail and Wealthbox are visible customer integrations, not evidence of internal deployment.
